presentation.purpose: Combine rows from one array with columns from another.

learning.title: Explore Matrix multiply in a classifier
learning.subtitle: Connect two arrays and check how their rows and columns combine.
learning.formula: Each output value combines one row from A with one column from B: multiply matching entries, then add those products.
paragraphs: Connect left operand A and right operand B. Their contraction dimensions must match; higher sample dimensions may broadcast under the existing contract. Observations remain separate.
Matrix multiply has no editable mathematics settings. Prepare dimensions explicitly with upstream tensor operations; Planned shapes shows both declared inputs and their product.
Results contains captured values after execution. Original contraction/broadcast lessons and exported programs retain their independent output and gradient checks.
